Package com.protonmail.landrevillejf.swingide.update

Class BundleUpdateInstaller

java.lang.Object
com.protonmail.landrevillejf.swingide.update.BundleUpdateInstaller
public class BundleUpdateInstaller extends Object
Applies a downloaded release bundle (lg3d-<version>.zip) to an installed Project Looking Glass tree.

The ported UpdateInstaller replaces a single running JAR (cp new.jar current.jar + java -jar current.jar), which cannot update lg3d: the desktop is a multi-jar bundle launched from a classpath by <root>/lg3d.sh. This installer closes that gap. It extracts the verified archive into a staging directory, then hands a deferred platform script the destructive work — snapshot the current managed entries (lib/ resources/ etc/ ext/ lg3d.sh README.txt VERSION) into a timestamped rollback directory, replace them with the staged tree, and optionally relaunch the desktop.

The replacement runs after the JVM exits (the script sleeps first), so the classpath jars are never rewritten under a live process. Relaunch defaults to off: under the LFS production target lg3d is the X session started by systemd/xinit, so killing it and letting the session manager bring it back is the safe posture; a windowed user can enable update.bundle.relaunch.

The two destructive steps (launchApplyScript(Path) and exitForRestart()) are protected so tests can assert the whole pipeline without spawning pkexec nor killing the test JVM, and every directory is injectable so tests never touch the real installation.
